messages:
Maya: We had a rough DB failover handoff this morning (~07:12 PT). Some customer writes were delayed and support flagged a few escalations. I'd like a quick post-incident debrief + a proposal for making action ownership more visible.

Jon: Agree. Template feels too open-ended. Suggest a compact template: incident window, customer impact tag, mitigation timeline (who/what), remediation actions with owner+ETA, verification metric. Keep it checklist-style.

Priya: For customer impact, let's standardize tags: NoImpact / Degraded / PartialOutage / FullOutage. Also include affected customer segments (e.g., "all customers in EU-west", or "enterprise customers only"). That will help Support craft consistent external messaging.

Alex: On actions: can we auto-create tasks in an "Incident Remediations" board? Bot could create a postmortem stub and add cards. Columns: Backlog, In Progress, Needs Verification, Verified, Blocked. Ideally each card has owner, due, verification metric.

oncall-bot: created PM-4932 (postmortem stub) for incident 1967801234. No actions yet. Use `/pm add-action PM-4932 "short desc" --owner @user --due YYYY-MM-DD --verify "<metric>"` to add.

Maya: Bot should also ping the owner and optionally schedule a short remediation check meeting when an action is moved to In Progress. Missing pings are why follow-ups stall.

Jon: +1. Also want auto-escalation: if overdue beyond policy (e.g., 7d enterprise, 14d default), escalate: DM owner -> manager -> team lead. Allow `--escalate-to <role|user>` flag.

Priya: Add a required "verification metric" on every action, e.g., "p50 latency < 200ms for 24h" or "error rate < 0.1% over 48h". That enables automated checks we can hook into the dashboard.

Alex: Technical note: we can pre-fill the mitigation timeline by ingesting alert events (pager joins/leaves, runbook steps). Proposal: webhook accepts payload with incident id and events; bot parses and injects timeline lines. Example payload:
```
{
  "incident": 1967801234,
  "events": [
    {"ts": 1967801235, "actor": "oncall@redwood", "action": "alert triggered: db_high_write_latency"},
    {"ts": 1967801300, "actor": "Maya", "action": "promoted replica -> primary (manual failover)"}
  ],
  "auto_create_actions": true
}
```

oncall-bot: webhook schema accepted. If `auto_create_actions:true` included, bot will suggest actions parsed from mitigation steps. Use POST to `https://pmbot.redwood.internal/webhook`.

Priya: Also surface anonymized support tickets as "customer examples" in the stub. Support can then reuse a one-line "customer-facing blurb" for comms. There should be a checkbox "PM/Support approve external blurb" before publishing.

Maya: Good call. And ensure the template includes a field for "quick external blurb" (one sentence) and a place for the approved comms owner.

Jon: For meeting cadence, let's run a short 30m postmortem sync tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll take notes and seed the timeline and hypothesis before the meeting.

oncall-bot: scheduled PM-4932 postmortem: 2026-03-16T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). Invited: Maya, Jon, Priya, Alex. Modify with `/pm update PM-4932 --time "2026-03-16T17:00:00Z"`.

Alex: I'll build a dashboard prototype and a small webhook consumer to prepopulate actions. Plan: branch + PR by EOD Friday.

Maya: Action list from thread:
1) Jon - seed PM-4932 with timeline & initial hypothesis (due: tomorrow 08:30 PT)
2) Priya - add customer impact & two anonymized tickets (due: tomorrow 08:30 PT)
3) Alex - dashboard + webhook prototype (due: Fri EOD)
4) Maya - finalize verification metrics for actions during the sync

Jon: Adding the actions now.

oncall-bot: action PM-4932-A1 "Verify runbook failover idempotency" created. Owner: @Jon. Due: 2026-03-23. Verification: "synthetic write/read succeeds across primaries for 24h". Card added to Incident Remediations / Backlog.

Priya: I'll add the external comms checkbox to the template and attach an anonymized support thread.

Alex: Also adding a small CLI helper for Support: `pm fetch-blurb PM-4932` that returns the customer-facing one-liner.

Maya: And please ensure actions include an `escalation_policy` tag so overdue items trigger the escalation flow where appropriate.

Jon: Sounds good. I'll keep notes and move action items into the board during the meeting.

oncall-bot: summary: PM-4932 created, 1 action added, postmortem scheduled. React :white_check_mark: if you've seen this.
